# Fintara Capital

> Pan-India institutional loan advisory and Direct Selling Agent (DSA) desk headquartered in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. We compare underwriting policies across 18+ leading national banks, Housing Finance Companies (HFCs), and NBFCs for retail, MSME, and corporate borrowers with zero borrower advisory fees.

## Official Coordinates
- Website: https://fintara.capital
- Office Address: Office No. 421, Walfort Omega, Raipur (C.G.), India
- Direct Helpline & WhatsApp: +91 95893 52662
- Official Email: fintaracapital@gmail.com
- Service Coverage: Pan-India (headquartered in Raipur, Chhattisgarh)
- Borrower Advisory Fee: ₹0 (100% free to borrowers; compensated by partner lending institutions upon disbursal)

## Core Loan Products
- [Home Loans](https://fintara.capital/loans/home-loan/): Purchase, plot + construction, self-construction, resale, and balance transfers up to 85% LTV and 30-year tenures.
- [Loan Against Property (LAP)](https://fintara.capital/loans/loan-against-property/): High-ticket commercial, residential, and industrial property mortgages up to ₹15+ Crore.
- [New Project Loans & Capex](https://fintara.capital/loans/project-loans/): Greenfield & brownfield industrial expansion, warehouses, cold storage, hospitals, hotels, and machinery term loans.
- [Working Capital Limits (Secured & Unsecured)](https://fintara.capital/loans/working-capital/): Secured Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft (OD), Drop-line OD, Bank Guarantee (BG), Letter of Credit (LC), and unsecured GST-linked revolving lines.
- [Unsecured Business Loans](https://fintara.capital/loans/business-loan/): Collateral-free SME loans up to ₹75 Lakhs evaluated on GST turnover and banking cash flows within 48–72 hours.
- [Personal Loans](https://fintara.capital/loans/personal-loan/): Fast-track unsecured financing up to ₹40 Lakhs for salaried employees and practicing professionals.
- [Balance Transfer & Top-Up](https://fintara.capital/balance-transfer/): Refinancing active high-rate loans to reduce monthly EMIs and unlock extra capital.
